scripts.build: mkdir -p "${PACKAGE_DIR:-bin}" && go build -o "${PACKAGE_DIR:-bin}/${BIN_NAME:-agenty-core}" ./cmd && if [ "${GOOS:-}" = "windows" ]; then cp ../patch-applier/target/release/apply_patch.exe "${PACKAGE_DIR:-bin}/apply_patch.exe"; else cp ../patch-applier/target/release/apply_patch "${PACKAGE_DIR:-bin}/apply_patch"; fi
